application_guidance.title: Choose the entry class
application_guidance.text: Confirm the class and current seat availability with the Hadapsar campus.

application_guidance.title: Use accurate student records
application_guidance.text: Complete application details so that identity, date-of-birth and previous-school records remain consistent.

application_guidance.title: Continue through the official application route
application_guidance.text: Use the campus application system and preserve the generated application reference and payment records.

application_guidance.title: Prepare verification documents
application_guidance.text: Keep identity, residence, previous-school and applicable guardianship / category documents ready.

application_guidance.title: Attend interaction where required
application_guidance.text: Class XI has a defined counselling and aptitude-test stage; other classes should follow the campus instructions issued for that admission.

application_guidance.title: Complete confirmation formalities
application_guidance.text: Confirm admission and fees only against the current school communication and published schedule.

policies.title: New-admission fees
policies.text: The general Hadapsar table on this page is specifically labelled for new admissions for 2026–27. Current school billing and official campus communication prevail if any figure is revised.

policies.title: Class XI is separate
policies.text: Class XI Science and Commerce are governed by the current Senior Secondary annexure and are displayed on the dedicated Class XI page rather than mixed into the general Nursery–XII table.

policies.title: Integrated Science
policies.text: The current Class XI annexure describes an Integrated Science Batch with Unacademy. The Unacademy fee is separate, payable directly to Unacademy, and requires completion of the school Class XI admission process.

policies.title: Availability and confirmation
policies.text: Fees and programme publication do not guarantee a seat. Admission remains subject to eligibility, document verification, campus process and formal confirmation.

class_xi.intro: Class XI 2026–27 at Hadapsar follows an online application, counselling and aptitude-test process before provisional admission. The campus currently offers Science and Commerce, with a separate Integrated Science option described in the annexure.

process.title: Online application
process.text: Fill the online form using the same correct details used for Class X Board registration.

process.title: Counselling + aptitude test
process.text: Visit the school with the printed application, signed annexure and required documents for the scheduled counselling session followed by the aptitude test.

process.title: Provisional admission
process.text: Provisional admission is based on interaction and aptitude-test performance, then reviewed after Board Examination results.

refund: If the student does not meet the applicable cut-off and the parent cancels: 100% refund within 10 calendar days of Board results, 50% within 15 calendar days, 25% within one calendar month, and no refund thereafter.
No refund applies where the student meets the criteria but the parent withdraws for another reason.
Applicable refunds are stated to be processed within 45 days by cheque.
The application form fee is non-refundable.
class_xi.fee_note: The annexure states a one-time ₹30,000 admission fee for new admissions directly into Class XII. Early-enrolment incentives dated 31 January 2026 are not displayed as an active offer because that date has passed.

integrated.title: Integrated Science Batch · Unacademy
integrated.text: The annexure states a discounted Unacademy fee of ₹1,80,000 taken together for Classes XI and XII. Students must first complete the Hadapsar Class XI admission process. The Unacademy amount is paid directly to Unacademy, and interested families are instructed to consult the Unacademy representative available on campus.

documents: Student and parent / legal guardian Aadhaar copies
Bonafide Certificate from the current school for non-Lexiconites
Class IX Report Card and Class X Mid-Term Report Card for non-Lexiconites
important: Direct admission in Class XII is subject to the applicable CBSE Board-transfer requirements.
Foreign nationals must submit the applicable Visa / Residence Permit / embassy documentation.
The annexure states that 75% attendance is mandatory once school starts, as per CBSE norms.
Families should separately budget for uniform, transport, trips, activities, co-curricular material and public / Board examination charges where applicable.
Submission of an application form does not guarantee admission.
